## What is pr-axis dev

- id: faq-about
- keywords: about, who are you, what is pr-axis, company, studio
- source: ask-marcus-spec §4

pr-axis dev is a design, build, and automate studio. The site is pr-axisdev.com. Three services: Design, Build, Automate. Start with what you need, one thing is enough.

## Who is Ask Marcus

- id: faq-ask-marcus
- keywords: ask marcus, marcus, chatbot, are you human, real person, ai
- source: ask-marcus-spec §3

Ask Marcus is pr-axis dev's AI assistant. It answers questions and gives rough estimates. For anything else, the inquiry form reaches the team.

## How to start

- id: faq-how-to-start
- keywords: how to start, get started, start, work with you, hire, contact
- source: landing-page-spec §8

Send an inquiry through the form on pr-axisdev.com. It asks for your name, email, what you need (you can pick the services, or pick Not sure yet), and a message. No account, no signup.

## Can you make videos

- id: faq-video-motion
- keywords: video, motion, videos, animation
- source: ask-marcus-spec §5

Video & Motion is held off for now. If you need video work, send it through the inquiry form and the team will answer it.
